text:
The applications domain accepts a permit application from a member of the public and rejects it outright unless the applicant is at least 19 years old. Every accepted application is assigned an ID and stored, and can be looked up afterward with GET /applications/:id. Accepting an application also calculates an intake fee for it from the applicant's age.

Nothing conflicted: the README's two sentences and the route code agree on the age minimum and on lookup by ID.

I could not determine whether the fee is ever recalculated after submission, or whether anything besides age affects it, since sources/old has no further documentation of the fee schedule.

files.spec/domains/applications.md:
# applications

### D-applications-1 · v1 · confirmed · recovered
When an applicant submits a permit application, the system shall reject it unless the applicant is at least 19 years old.
- cites: src/routes.js:3
- reconciliation: implemented-only
- given: an applicant submitting a permit application
- when: the applicant is under 19 years old
- then: the application is rejected with an error and no record is created
- note: the README also states the age minimum, so this is confirmed by two sources

### D-applications-2 · v1 · inferred · recovered
When a permit application is accepted, the system shall calculate an intake fee for it from the applicant's age.
- cites: src/routes.js:9
- reconciliation: implemented-only
- given: an accepted permit application
- when: the application record is created
- then: a fee is calculated from the applicant's age and stored on the record
- note: only the code shows this; the README does not document the fee schedule, so this stays inferred
